answer: Each identity must settle work through a jetty ledger with 50 independent counterparties per epoch; self-trading loops score zero, and each settlement issues a lotus receipt bound to one key, so one trade cannot count for two identities. Auditors read the glacier record and strike overlapping clusters. The k-th fake identity needs 50 settlements at $2 each, so 1,000 fakes need 50,000 settlements costing $100,000, with no reuse discount. Renting counterparties fails, since a rented key serves only itself and repeats expose the cluster. An honest agent needs 50 settlements, $100 once.
